## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Instagram post on the brand's own account, organic (no paid promotion), UK audience. Timing not given.

**Checks run**
- **Claims:** one fails.
  - "made with zero waste from farm to cup" is not on the policy list and has no source in this chat. It is an absolute environmental claim covering the whole supply chain, and the policy only backs the tea bags being plastic-free and home compostable.
  - "plastic-free tea bags" and "plastic-free and home compostable" are both on the policy list.
  - "New tins just landed" is a new-arrival product fact and is fine as written. It is not fake urgency.
  - The tin colours and lettering are product facts and are fine.
- **Regulated claims (environment):** "zero waste from farm to cup" is the kind of broad green claim regulators challenge most. In the UK, the CMA and ASA expect environmental claims to be specific and backed by evidence. Without proof it has to come out.
- **House style:** the copy is clean, with no AI tells or banned phrases. The only weakness is that "plastic-free tea bags" is said twice in three short sentences.
- **Disclosure:** none needed. It is the brand's own organic post, with no creator, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-generated imagery mentioned. If the tin photos are AI-generated, add a label.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite, not yet approved):**
> New tins just landed for winter. Deep green, gold lettering, and the same plastic-free, home compostable tea bags inside.

- Removed "made with zero waste from farm to cup".
- Merged the two tea bag sentences into one. Both claims in it are on the policy list.

**Needs a decision**
1. Do you have evidence for "zero waste from farm to cup", such as a certification or a supply chain audit? If so, share it and add it to the policy. It would still need to be narrowed to what the evidence covers. My suggested answer is to publish without it.
2. Are the tin photos real photography? If any are AI-generated, add a label.

**Approver:** the policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you to the exact final text above. Approval of the original draft doesn't carry over. Nothing is recorded or sent until you confirm.

**Evidence log rows** (paste into the team's log):

| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | IG winter tins post | tea bags are plastic-free | On policy list | Brand policy |
| 2026-11-17 | IG winter tins post | tea bags are home compostable | On policy list | Brand policy |
| 2026-11-17 | IG winter tins post | made with zero waste from farm to cup | Unproven, removed | None |
